itens.resumo: We announced the deprecation of the Claude Opus 4.5 model ( claude-opus-4-5-20251101 and claude-opus-4-5 ), with retirement on the Claude API scheduled for January 22, 2027. We recommend migrating to Claude Opus 5.5. See Migrating from Claude Opus 4.5 or earlier . To check which dates apply on other platforms, see Model deprecations . We’ve launched Enterprise Frontier Safeguards (EFS) in beta on Claude Platform , Claude Platform on AWS , and Claude Models on Google Cloud (Anthropic managed) . EFS is Zero Data Retention (ZDR) for eligible organizations that use Claude’s most capable models . Anthropic doesn’t retain your prompts and responses. Encrypted copies of them, called Sealed Safety Data, go to a bucket in your own cloud account. itens.titulo: Claude Platform — November 17, 2026
itens.resumo: We’ve launched Linked billing in beta with the user-profiles-billing-2026-10-01 beta header. Your customers can now pay for the Claude usage in your app through their own Claude organization. Once a customer links their organization, set billing_policy on each /v1/messages or /v1/chat/completions request to choose who pays. In the Claude Console, customers can set a spend cap for your app or unlink your app. Linked billing works for customers whose organization pays Anthropic directly for API usage.

itens.resumo: Text generated by Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Opus 4.5, Claude Sonnet 4.5, and Claude Haiku 4.5 carries Anthropic’s text watermark on supported platforms. How Claude marks AI-generated content lists those platforms. If a request to one of these models sets temperature , top_p , or top_k to a non-default value, the text might not carry the watermark. See Text watermark . We’ve added two event types to organization webhooks , which are in beta. We send external_key.failed when your key management service keeps refusing a customer-managed encryption key, and external_key.recovered when the key works again.
